capacity_diagnostic.early_stopping: maximize the primary mean per-protein AP on each frozen inner validation fold; use the median best epoch across the three inner folds for outer refit
capacity_diagnostic.loss: binary cross entropy with training-only class-balanced sample weights

label_semantics.claim_limit: does not represent strict direct ordered-versus-disordered truth
label_semantics.negative: direct DisProt ordered residue or residue observed in experimental PDB
label_semantics.unknown: mask=0; excluded from fitting and scoring

linear_arms.inner_selection: arithmetic mean of per-protein AP across all inner held proteins; tie selects smaller C
linear_arms.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit only on the current training residues

pretrained_model_inference: pre-extracted fixed-revision representations; no model weights or label-selected feature extraction
primary_metric: arithmetic mean per-protein average precision over outer held-out proteins
scope: retrospective development-only grouped evaluation; candidate reference labels only

splits.invalid_fold: fail before scoring; do not omit groups or labels

traditional_baseline.features: 20-AA one-hot, relative position, and centered local 15-residue 20-AA composition
traditional_baseline.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit only on current training residues
traditional_baseline.reader: same balanced binary LogisticRegression and C grid

uncertainty.scope: paired bootstrap conditional on fixed outer predictions

unit: protein residue, with equal-weight per-protein primary aggregation
